verdicts.note: 仮定法過去。主節would buyに対応しbe動詞はwere。
仮定法過去のif節(had)に対し主節はwould+原形。
主節would goより仮定法過去。be動詞はwere。
if I knewに対し仮定法過去の主節would call。
if you studiedに対し仮定法過去の主節could。wouldは選択肢になく、canは時制不一致。
If I were you の定型。
仮定法過去完了。if had studiedに対し主節would have passed。
主節would have caughtより仮定法過去完了。if節はhad left。
if had takenに対し主節would have arrived。on timeは到着動詞arriveが自然。
if had knownに対し主節would have told。

verdicts.multiple_valid_note: 標準解はwould not have been(過去の結果)。ただしlateを現在の状態と解釈すれば混合仮定法でwould not be(index0)も文法的に成立する(過去のif節+現在の主節)。本問の単元主旨では過去完了一致のindex3が主。
verdicts.note: 仮定法過去完了の一致でwould not have been。
I wish節では助動詞はcould。canは直説法で不可。
I wish + 仮定法過去のbe動詞はwere。
過去(when I was young)への後悔ゆえI wish + 過去完了had studied。
he knewの仮定法と結ぶのはas if(まるで〜のように)。

verdicts.produced_sentence: Without water, we could not live.
verdicts.note: Without構文の仮定法。

verdicts.produced_sentence: If I had time, I would help you.
verdicts.note: 仮定法過去。

verdicts.produced_sentence: I wish I were a bird.
verdicts.note: I wish I were a bird. の語順のみ成立。

verdicts.produced_sentence: If he had left early, he would have made it.
verdicts.note: 仮定法過去完了。

verdicts.produced_sentence: She talks as if she were a doctor.
verdicts.note: as if + 仮定法過去。

verdicts.produced_sentence: Without your help, I would fail.
verdicts.note: Without構文の仮定法。トークンfailに句読点が無いため末尾にピリオドを補った。

verdicts.produced_sentence: If I were free now, I could help you.
verdicts.multiple_valid_note: can/cannotの意味保持指示よりcould helpが主。wouldを使うと能力の意味が落ちるため不可。代替としてIf I were free now, I would be able to help you. も同義で成立。
verdicts.note: 仮定法過去。canの意味はcouldで保持。

verdicts.produced_sentence: If I had had time, I would have called you.
verdicts.note: 仮定法過去完了。had had / would have called。
cannot swim → I wish I could swim。

verdicts.produced_sentence: I wish I had studied hard.
verdicts.note: 過去への後悔ゆえI wish + 過去完了had studied。
